subject: @abh/core real tool call prepare, adapter, output validation, artifact storage, and terminal CAS lifecycle
coverage: prepare commits a Pending call only after binding, deadline, purpose, grant, fence, idempotency, and call-limit checks
adapter receives the frozen binding, call key, arguments, and target refs after prepare commits
successful output is validated by an explicitly installed validator
validated output is stored through the bounded Inline Artifact Owner
result artifact owner is the terminal tool call and sources include binding, capability, and target refs
artifact storage and Completed CAS commit atomically
explicit failed result with a digest performs a one-way Failed CAS
adapter throw, timeout, unknown shape, output rejection, or oversized artifact keeps Pending
replaying a Pending call does not invoke the adapter again
replaying terminal states returns stable references without another remote call
Pending calls consume binding call capacity
HTTP installation requires explicit tool adapter, output validator, and result storage
limits: production remote tool transport remains host-installed and is not bundled
failed calls do not yet persist a separate evidence artifact
tool cost reservation and usage settlement remain open
background binding expiry archiving remains open
